verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; creative refresh is already underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 41 purchases on $1,537.64 in spend, returning $6,398.10 in revenue at a 4.16 return on ad spend. The concern is the final 7 days: purchases fell 36% and return on ad spend dropped 69% versus the prior 7-day period, with the last three days confirming the trend rather than a single off day. The lead cause is creative fatigue on your top campaign, which absorbed 56% of total spend against an audience pool that has seen the same ads for weeks. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reset performance, and UTM tracking is being finalized so revenue attribution reads cleanly going forward. If the new creative lands well, purchase volume should stabilize within the first half of next period.
